title: ping_l2 suite: 3 tests fail at base (TX -ENOENT from lichen_link_tx, publish_app_identity, UDP bind) - pre-existing, differential-proven
description: Found during project-LICHEN-worker6-sb0b validation. On the pinned v3.7.0 builder (clean worktree, origin/main+base 95116be9ed for the touched files), ping_l2 with the OLD rx_thread code restored gives the identical 4-pass/3-fail set as the new async code: FAIL test_full_l2_loopback_ping (lichen_l2_tx -> lichen_link_tx returns -ENOENT 'TX frame build failed: unknown error (-2)' + crash_info CRASH_STATE_CORRUPTION at lichen_l2_tx.c:154), FAIL test_l2_publish_app_identity_uses_link_context_key (publish returns non-zero), FAIL test_udp_payload_reaches_socket_after_l2_injection (bind UDP observer: -ENOENT). So the failures are pre-existing drift between the test's expectations and current link/SCHC/identity code, NOT caused by the RX refactor. ping_l2 has been unrunnable for a while (coap_status.c -Werror=switch-enum + CONFIG_COAP_SERVER_MESSAGE_SIZE assert + COAP_CLIENT_THREAD_PRIORITY=NUM_PREEMPT_PRIORITIES boot assert + base rx_stack symbol collision with net_tc.c), so these accumulated silently. Debug the -ENOENT from lichen_link_tx first (likely SCHC rule or key provisioning drift), then the identity publish and UDP bind paths. prj.conf unblocks (MESSAGE_SIZE=1024, COAP_CLIENT_THREAD_PRIORITY=14) are already in place from sb0b.
close_reason: Family complete: all three children closed (5fva.1/.2/.3) — every failure mode fixed by the worker-3 chain on beads-worker-3 (84908feee9, 237dc35064, 24cde81e5a, cf9afa78a1, 75b86d62cd) and the suite validated 7/7 PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL on heft (validation bead 1j89, closed). The bead's original 'pre-existing drift between test expectations and current link/SCHC/identity code' diagnosis was correct; the drift decomposed into five distinct defects (nonce/epoch semantics, TX capacity, E=1 key policy, SIID-keyed peer identity, loopback re-arm protocol), each individually reviewed 3x and landed. Note: .1's original -ENOENT symptom signature was superseded as the chain progressed (-ENOKEY -> -EPROTONOSUPPORT -> -ENOMEM -> EALREADY); full trail in the child beads and 07s1.
